title: Android HorizontalScrollView: RTL touch scrolling
purpose: Check that Android XML HorizontalScrollView starts at the correct edge and scrolls naturally in right-to-left layout, while two rows keep independent positions.
changes: Right-to-left content now starts at its right-hand logical start, and swiping right moves toward later items. Short content also aligns to the right. The example has a direction switch and two independently scrollable rows.
steps: On a phone-sized screen, turn on Right-to-left layout before scrolling either row. The first item in each row (A1 and B1) should be at the right-hand end.
Swipe the first row toward the right to reveal later items such as A4. The second row should stay in its original position.
Swipe the second row toward the right to reveal later items such as B4. The first row should stay where you left it.
Swipe either row back toward the left. It should return toward its first item without moving the other row.
Optionally turn off Right-to-left layout and check that left-to-right content is scrolled in the opposite direction. The current logical positions are retained when the switch changes.
Choose OK if the rows behave as described. Otherwise choose Reject and explain which step failed, what you saw and your device.
expected: In RTL, each row begins on the right with its first item and a rightward swipe reveals later items. The two rows scroll independently and stay within their content bounds.
limits: This tests the example's Android XML horizontal scroll containers and touch interaction at phone width. Short-content placement is covered by an automated test. Exact Android fling physics, wheel conventions and device pixel parity remain open. A very wide viewport may fit all items and require no scrolling.

references.scope: Initial scroll position at the right-hand logical start in RTL.

validation: All 157 Rust android_xml tests passed, including logical start, touch direction, end clamping and short-content RTL placement.
Seven scroll indicator and scrollbar tests passed after the shared horizontal touch controller change.
Browser test-bhoo-android-horizontal-rtl.mjs passed RTL touch scrolling and independence of the two rows at 390px width.
